annotation.title_clean: Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the Development of Artificial Intelligence in the Russian Federation (National Strategy for the Development of AI up to 2030)
annotation.title_en: Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the Development of Artificial Intelligence in the Russian Federation (National Strategy for the Development of AI up to 2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the President of the Russian Federation (translation by CSET, Georgetown)
annotation.summary_en: English translation of Russia's 2019 presidential decree No. 490 approving the National Strategy for AI Development to 2030. It sets goals for research, data availability, computing resources, talent and regulatory frameworks to make Russia a leading AI power. Robotics appears only as a related area of use.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves the National Strategy for AI Development up to 2030 and directs the government to create a federal project 'Artificial Intelligence'.
Sets priorities for basic and applied AI research, including artificial general intelligence.
Calls for expanded datasets, computing infrastructure, and AI talent training.
Calls for a regulatory framework and an integrated security system for AI technologies.
Requires annual progress reports to the President and strategy updates every three years.
